title: Ledger Cancellation Groups
brief: Our ledger service records balance adjustments as signed integers. Before the books close, auditors want to review every group of three adjustments that cancel each other out exactly.
Implement findCancelingTriples(nums), where nums holds the adjustments, and return the distinct groups of three values that add up to zero.
